mcq_drop.why: ambiguous 'immediate chronological predecessor' (e.g. Sambamurthy 1987, Indra Sawhney 1992 fall between)

pyq_bad.why: wrong options: match codes truncated to single numerals

patterns: APPSC asks direct single facts: Right to Privacy under Article 21; S.R. Bommai decided by a nine-judge bench.
Other PSCs/UPSC repeat privacy-Article items, 'Caged Parrot' = Coalgate, Section 377 IPC (not Article 377) trap, equal pay = Arts 14 and 16 with 'Socialist'.
Case-amendment matching (Raj Narain-39th, Minerva-42nd, Kihoto-52nd, Sambamurthy-32nd) is a recurring shape; Sambamurthy gives the AP link.
App MCQs are far heavier on match/A-R/chronology items, bench sizes and 2023-26 rulings than the PYQs, which stay at case-to-Article level.
